variants.proposal: Per-request decoder preparation and owner publication
variants.conditions: Backend must expose genuinely preparable work;preserve prompt priming,special tokens,UTF8 recovery and publication-before-first-use. Long wall profile does not establish backend cause/GIL behavior.

variants.proposal: Per-request serial offload with ordered owner publication
variants.conditions: Serial stream mutation;request generation and cancel/abort guard;publish structured results on owner event loop;bound work-in-flight and prove backend thread safety.

variants.proposal: Emission policy or serialization batching after semantic processing
variants.conditions: Reuse existing merge/chunk/yield baseline;preserve DELTA/CUMULATIVE/FINAL_ONLY,first/final/interval behavior,all fields,one-shot prompt logprobs,parent andresumable-input lifecycle;explicit latency budget.

variants.proposal: Optional compiled or shared immutable stop matcher
variants.conditions: Only if stop matching is relevant;preserve earliest end/list-order ties,min_tokens eligibility,overlap window,holdback and UTF8 semantics;do not fuse chunks across stop/finish boundaries.
